subject: an ancient Greek philosopher of the 4th century BC with short neat hair, a trimmed beard, a thoughtful focused face, wearing a draped wool himation over a tunic and simple sandals

panels.01-stagira: a small ancient Greek coastal town on a green hillside in northern Greece in 384 BC, stone walls, terracotta roofs, olive trees, the sea beyond, a physician's house with herbs drying by the door, wide establishing shot, classical antiquity
panels.02-academy: a seventeen-year-old Greek youth in a simple tunic sitting among older students in a shady olive grove outside ancient Athens, listening to an elderly broad-shouldered bearded teacher, scrolls and a wax tablet, 4th century BC, the Academy
panels.03-assos: {S} standing at the rail of an ancient Greek merchant ship with a square sail leaving the harbour of Athens, looking toward the open Aegean sea, scrolls in a wooden case at his feet, 347 BC, a new journey
panels.04-lesbos: {S} kneeling at the edge of a calm sunlit lagoon on the Greek island of Lesbos, examining an octopus and small fish in a shallow clay basin, a fisherman with a net beside him explaining, a younger companion taking notes on a wax tablet, 345 BC, curiosity
panels.05-alexander: {S} teaching a thirteen-year-old Macedonian prince with tousled hair in the gardens of a royal estate at Mieza, stone benches, a cave and trees behind, an open scroll of Homer between them, 343 BC, calm instruction
panels.06-lyceum: {S} walking along a shaded stone colonnade at the Lyceum in ancient Athens, talking with a group of students who walk beside him, shelves of scrolls visible through an open doorway, plane trees, golden afternoon light, 335 BC, the Peripatetic school
panels.07-chalcis: an elderly {S} with a grey beard sitting quietly in the courtyard of a modest country house on the island of Euboea in 322 BC, writing a scroll at a small table, a younger student standing respectfully nearby, the sea in the distance, calm and dignified
panels.08-ruins: the excavated stone foundations of an ancient gymnasium in a green park in modern Athens, low walls and the outline of a colonnade among cypress and pine trees, soft morning light, peaceful, timeless, no people
